note: Small campground beside the long sand beach of Namekus Lake, 10 km south of Waskesiu off Highway 263 in Prince Albert National Park. The 14 drive-in sites are raised gravel back-ins in the woods behind the beach; the other 6 are walk-in tent sites. The lake is closed to motorized boats. Fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Keep; not waterfront kept. Parks Canada: 20 unserviced first-come sites, 14 of them back-ins for trailers up to 24 ft (a 23-ft rig fits), 6 walk-in tent sites; pit toilets, no water. Season mid-May to late October written. Fees: shoulder $16.25 now nightly_low. Pin OK. Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (could be lakeview; unconfirmed). The Parks Canada campground map puts the drive-in sites 2-15 on a loop behind the beach, with the inner loop road, day-use, the fish station and parking between them and the lake; on Esri z17 the loop sits in forest ~50-100 m back from the water. No site photos found, so no view could be confirmed; the walk-in tent sites 16-21 are the ones on the beach.
